payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate sale-summary is another concrete consumer of the async side-effect projection gap: the Rust projection uses Frick's synchronous apply hook and spawns async store read/upsert work to materialize SaleSummary rows. This reinforces the reusable need for a first-class async projection side-effect seam in Frick rather than per-app spawned-task bridges.
